minor_observations.detail: pricing.go uses minor-unit constants (6000, 150000) but the header comment says '60 THB / 1500 THB'. TD §11.2 quotes whole-THB integers (60 / 1500) as the spec boundary. Implementation is correct — all arithmetic is in minor units and minorToTHB() converts for the response. No defect.

computeRequestHash (handler_commit.go:478-481) uses json.Marshal on the raw-message map which produces non-deterministic key order for nested objects. For the flat single-key MVP body (shippingAddressId only) this is safe. A canonical-JSON library is noted as a future improvement in the code comment.
minor_observations.action: acceptable for MVP; track as tech-debt

minor_observations.detail: handler_commit.go step 0: when ABANDONED status is encountered it falls through to the COMPLETED case (switch merges StatusCompleted and StatusAbandoned on line 106). The ABANDONED envelope holds a 504 UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT per the janitor spec, so the cached timeout is correctly replayed. Behaviour matches TD spec.

finalizeAndReturn passes empty string for orderID to sagaLogStore.Write on early-error paths (steps 1-5) where no orderId has been generated yet. saga_log.order_id is UUID NOT NULL in the migration. This will cause an INSERT error which is silently ignored (the error from Write is discarded with '_='). The idempotency commit still succeeds; saga_log simply misses the early-error rows. Not a correctness issue for the happy path but worth addressing.
minor_observations.action: low-priority fix: skip saga_log write when orderID is empty, or make order_id nullable with a note

summary: All 8 conformance checks PASS. The checkout service implementation faithfully matches td.json: both routes registered, §11.2 shipping tier canonically in pricing.go with int64 minor units and no duplication, idempotency flow covers lookup→INFLIGHT→COMPLETED/ABANDONED with correct status enum, all 9 orchestration steps present in order, all 3 compensation paths wired with backoff and DEGRADED saga marking, client-priced and couponCode fields rejected at validation, X-Internal-Secret on order calls, and both migrations present. Four low-severity observations noted; none block release.
